newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss to destroy last Solar Temple farm.
newsitem.headline: Swiss to destroy last Solar Temple farm.

text.p: A farmhouse near the Swiss city of Fribourg, where 23 members of the Order of the Solar Temple died in a mass murder-suicide in October 1994, will be demolished to avoid it becoming a place of pilgrimage, a judge said on Friday.
None of the families of the victims found at the burning farmhouse in the village of Cheiry wanted to claim the property, which has been bought by Fribourg canton.
Judge Jean-Luc Baechler approved a request by the Fribourg government to destroy the farmhouse, which is expected to be pulled down in the next weeks.
"We wanted to forget this affair and avoid the farmhouse becoming a place of pilgrimage," Baechler told Reuters.
"It would be a sinister reminder, just like they decided to destroy that school in Scotland," he added, referring to the killing of 16 children and their teacher at Dunblane last March.
Three chalets at the village of Granges-sur-Salvan, in Valais canton, where 25 charred corpses of the doomsday cult members were found the same day, were destroyed last May.

Andre Pillar, the Fribourg judge who led Swiss inquiries into the deaths, said in his final report last April that he thought all but 15 of the 53 victims had been murdered with guns or poison or by asphyxiation. The victims were mainly Swiss and French, but included Canadians, Belgians and a Spaniard.
Sixteen members of the Solar Temple, half of whom were Swiss, died in an outdoor murder-suicide in southeastern France in December 1995.
